name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 4 – Am 71
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 4. Stresses the need for the Commission to provide reliable, timely, and accurate information on the borrowing costs of the NGEU and on the projected disbursements under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, in accordance with the methodology applied since the 2025 budget, according to which the Commission will base the budgeting of the EURI interest line for a given year on disbursements confirmed by the end of the third quarter of the previous year;
